description: This Java class 'BitmapUtils' provides utility methods for loading and processing images and descriptions, including caching bitmaps and creating thumbnails, for an Android application.

classes.name: BitmapUtils
classes.description: Utility class for loading images, creating thumbnails, and caching bitmaps for an Android app.

methods.name: loadPhotos
methods.description: Loads a list of PictureData objects with randomly selected images and descriptions, creating thumbnails.

methods.name: getBitmap
methods.description: Retrieves a bitmap from cache or loads it from resources if not cached.

methods.name: getThumbnail
methods.description: Creates a scaled thumbnail bitmap from the original bitmap based on a maximum dimension.
